_comment: A recorded page layout, in the exact shape MockLayoutAnalyzer replays.
Structure mirrors what the Qwen2.5-VL prompt returns, so a live run can be
recorded here (art parse --record) and replayed offline forever after.
Coordinates are pixels on a 1000x1400 page render at 180 DPI.
Deliberately included: a two-row merged header, a merged footer row, a
declared unit note (单位：人民币千元), issuer-supplied bilingual glosses, a
chart, and a wide statement. These are the cases that break naive parsers.

regions.label: text
regions.text: The board of directors presents the audited consolidated results of the Group for the year ended 31 December 2023, together with the comparative figures for 2022, prepared under IFRS (国际财务报告准则) as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board.

regions.label: text
regions.text: Unless otherwise stated, all amounts are presented in Renminbi. Revenue (营业收入) is recognised when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to the customer. EBITDA (息税折旧摊销前利润) is a non-IFRS measure defined in note 3.

regions.label: image
regions.alt_text: Company seal and auditor signature block

regions.label: text
regions.text: This document is a translation sample used for pipeline demonstration purposes only.

regions.label: text
regions.text: The Group delivered record revenue in 2023, with growth across all three reporting segments. Gross margin improved by 1.8 percentage points to 42.5% as cloud services scaled.

regions.label: table
regions.caption: Financial Summary 主要财务数据

cells.text: Note: EBITDA is a non-IFRS measure. Gross margin is stated as a percentage of revenue.

regions.label: text
regions.text: The board recommends a final dividend per share (每股股息) of RMB 0.42, subject to approval at the annual general meeting.

chart.description: Grouped bar chart comparing 2023 against 2022 revenue for three reporting segments. Cloud services grew from RMB660,567 thousand to RMB903,144 thousand, enterprise software from RMB486,391 thousand to RMB529,075 thousand, and hardware and others from RMB389,246 thousand to RMB410,117 thousand.

regions.label: text
regions.text: 第二章 管理层讨论与分析

regions.label: text
regions.text: Revenue increased by 19.9% year on year to RMB 1,842,336 thousand, driven primarily by cloud services which grew 36.7%. Working capital management improved, and cash and cash equivalents (现金及现金等价物) rose to RMB 604,882 thousand from RMB 438,110 thousand in 2022.

regions.label: text
regions.text: Capital expenditure (资本开支) of RMB 215,400 thousand was directed at data centre capacity. Depreciation and amortisation (折旧及摊销) increased to RMB 99,122 thousand, reflecting the expanded asset base.

regions.label: text
regions.text: Total assets (资产总额) were RMB 4,318,660 thousand at 31 December 2023, and total liabilities (负债总额) were RMB 1,587,224 thousand, giving a gearing ratio (资产负债率) of 36.8%.

cells.text: Net cash used in investing activities

regions.label: text
regions.text: Segment information (分部资料) is presented on the same basis as the internal reports reviewed by the chief operating decision maker. Inter-segment transactions are eliminated on consolidation.

cells.text: Note: segment result is stated before unallocated corporate expenses of RMB 12,469 thousand (2022: RMB 11,325 thousand).

regions.label: text
regions.text: The comparative figures for 2022 have been restated to reflect the reallocation of shared platform costs between segments. This restatement does not affect total revenue or total segment result.
